mapper.select: select * from owner order by o_no desc
mapper.insert: insert into owner(o_no, o_id, o_passwd, o_name, o_tel, o_email,o_addr,o_zipno,o_join_date,o_authority) values(owner_seq.nextval, #{o_id}, #{o_passwd}, #{o_name}, #{o_tel}, #{o_email}, #{o_addr}, #{o_zipno}, sysdate, 'USER' )
mapper.update: UPDATE owner SET o_tel = #{o_tel},o_email = #{o_email},o_addr = #{o_addr},o_zipno = #{o_zipno} WHERE o_id = #{o_id}
